summary:
"ASTRO HEALTH CHECK" is a little software I built to make daily health checks easy for astronauts, for the NASA Space Apps 2026 challenge. It works without internet, and everything stays on your own device.

When you open it, you see three big buttons: add your daily log, see your health report, or open the emergency guide. If more than one person shares the app, each crew member gets their own history.

The daily log asks one simple question at a time: heart rate, blood pressure, temperature, oxygen, breathing, sleep and exercise. If you don't have the right device, it doesn't leave you stuck. It shows an easy way to measure by hand, like counting your pulse, or just asks how you're feeling. You can skip anything you can't do.

The health report tells you how you're doing in plain words. A body figure lights up green, yellow or red, and you can tap any part to see what it means. Below that are the actions you should take, and a graph that shows how your health is changing over time.

If something serious comes up, the emergency guide walks you through what to do, starting with a heart attack. Temperature works in °C or °F, and the app remembers your choice.

You can add a shortcut for this in a web browser, so it opens like a normal app.
details: Astro Health Check is a small offline software I built for the NASA Space Apps 2026 Health Monitoring challenge, to help astronauts look after their health on long missions when a doctor on Earth isn’t always a quick call away. It needs internet for first opening though. Each day, the app asks simple questions about heart rate, blood pressure, temperature, oxygen, breathing, sleep and exercise, and if a device isn’t available it shows an easy way to check by hand. It then turns the answers into a health report: a body figure that lights up green, yellow or red, clear next steps, and a graph of how your health is changing over time. If something serious happens, an emergency guide gives calm, step-by-step help for situations like a heart attack or trouble breathing. Each crew member keeps their own history, and everything stays on the device. It installs on a phone like a normal app and works without internet.
